_doc.what: Synergy CANDIDATES from code (pairs are [code]), not measurements. Scope: catalog cards DEFECT+COLORLESS, relics DEFECT+SHARED+EVENT. Rebuild: python tools/synergy.py --build defect (needs decomp/). Bundles with tag 'community' passed the pooled pick-given-offer check (community = {outcome: [effect, lo, hi, BH q]}, n = picks while owning a partner).
_doc.tags: provides = mechanics the item produces; consumes = provider mechanics it pays off (consumes strength_gain = strength payoff); converts m1>m2 = engine turning m1 into m2 (bridge for indirect pairs). Authored: provides/consumes/converts, cite {m: decomp file:line, overrides the regex src}, sim = crates/sts2sim/src/content file:line of the item's implementation; auto from decomp/catalog: exhaust_self/ethereal/retain (CanonicalKeywords), strike/defend (CanonicalTags), x_cost (+consumes energy_gain), sly (Sly keyword), osty_attack (OstyAttack tag), zero_cost (cost 0), power_card, high_cost (cost>=2), mp_only (MultiplayerOnly: no pairs).
_doc.src: per mechanic: decomp file:line under decomp/MegaCrit.Sts2.Core.Models.{Cards,Relics,Powers}/ (first line matching the mechanic's pattern in the item's file or a power it applies); 'catalog' = data/catalog.json; 'text' = localization only (unverified).
_doc.pairs: direct: a provides via, b consumes it. indirect (A + B need one of needs): role bridge = a provides m1, b consumes m2, needs convert m1>m2 (via m1>m2); role source = a, b both consume via (rules.hard), neither provides it, needs = its providers; role payoff = a, b both provide via, neither consumes it, needs = its consumers; source / payoff skipped when a starter card or relic supplies the need; rules.extra with needs = authored indirect. anti: a suppresses b (rules.anti, note, src = a's decomp line). anti excludes direct/indirect for the same pair.
_doc.bundles: rules.bundles: mechanics -> members touching them; core = cards consuming/converting a bundle mechanic or Power cards providing it (+ plans.json core/enablers/payoffs; relics when < 3 cards); anti = anti partners of core via bundle-relevant mechanics.
_doc.vocab: strength_gain dexterity_gain multi_hit vulnerable_apply weak_apply exhaust_enabler exhaust_self ethereal hp_loss_self hp_loss_reduce block_gain block_retain power_card draw energy_gain x_cost high_cost status_generator attack_volume skill_volume card_volume autoplay card_generation upgrade_gain strike defend retain potion_gain gold_gain enchant | defect: orb_channel lightning frost dark plasma glass evoke orb_passive focus orb_slot orb_variety status_combat zero_cost_attack (definitions in rules.pat)
_doc.rules: pat {m: {p: provider regex, c: consumer regex, desc}} adds character mechanics; hard [{m, roles: source|payoff, note, pure?: selector, with?: [m]}] = mechanics whose consumers (source) or providers (payoff) do nothing alone: pairs need >= 1 member in pure (default all), with adds providers of those mechanics to the needs; anti / extra selectors: ID list, ID, provides:m, consumes:m, converts_to:m, cost0.
_doc.cross: other-pool cards (Sea Glass-type offers, random any-pool generation): every other character's own cards join tags with pool = CHAR (tags from that character's table) and unfueled = {m: same-pool providers} for a consumed resource (synergy.FUEL + that table's hard source mechanics) no host-scope item provides; orb_slot always counts off-Defect (a 0-slot character gets 1 slot on its first channel, Commands/OrbCmd.cs:74). Pairs with cross = CHAR join exactly one other-pool card to the host scope (host + that character's rules; GENERIC mechanics skipped since any host card supplies them alike). Pairs among two other-pool cards live in that character's own table.

orb_channel.desc: channels an orb; consumers count, evoke or re-trigger held orbs

lightning.desc: channels Lightning (passive 3 / evoke 8 to a random enemy, +Focus); consumers pay off Lightning held, channeled or evoked

frost.desc: channels Frost (end-of-turn 2 Block / evoke 5, +Focus, Unpowered); consumers need Frost held

dark.desc: channels Dark (each passive adds 6+Focus to its evoke; evoke hits the lowest-HP enemy); consumers re-trigger held Dark

plasma.desc: channels Plasma (start-of-turn +1 energy / evoke +2; not Focus-scaled)

glass.desc: channels Glass (end-of-turn AoE 4+Focus, base decays 1 per trigger to 0 but Focus keeps it firing; evoke AoE 2x passive)

evoke.desc: evokes orbs outside overflow; consumers trigger on evoke (Thunder) or channel Dark whose value is its evoke

orb_passive.desc: triggers orb passives extra times; consumers channel orbs whose passive pays

focus.desc: gains Focus (+value to Lightning/Frost/Dark-passive/Glass, not Plasma, floor 0); consumers channel or re-trigger those orbs

orb_slot.desc: adds orb slots (cap 10); consumers hold or channel many orbs at once

orb_variety.desc: channels several orb types; consumers scale with distinct types held

status_combat.desc: creates Status cards in combat with you as creator (enemy-added Statuses do not trigger Smokestack / Trash to Treasure / Rocket Punch); curses to deck are status_generator

zero_cost_attack.desc: Attack that costs 0 when played; consumers return 0-energy Attacks

zero_cost.desc: costs 0 when played; consumers return, keep or fetch 0-cost cards
